description: React component 'DetailsViewer' for displaying structured details of objects, with features like collapsible nested objects/arrays, formatting of timestamps, currency, tokens, durations, optional raw JSON view, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns JSON.stringify with fallback, converts payload to string or indicates inability to render.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a human-readable label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key string resembles a timestamp.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key string resembles token counts.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key string resembles duration or latency.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a number representing seconds or milliseconds into a human-readable duration string.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key string is likely to represent a currency amount.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key's implied type (currency, token, duration, timestamp).

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Determines whether a node should be collapsed initially based on its depth.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: Subcomponent providing collapsible section UI for nested objects.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with formatting and styling.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent id and name from an object, handling various possible property names.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders nodes, handling objects, arrays, and primitives, with special handling for 'agents' arrays and objects.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, ordered with highlights first and alphabetically.
